<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>

<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#11161d">
<title>JBL 9.4.6全景声影院</title>
<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;font-family:Inter,"Microsoft YaHei","PingFang SC",sans-serif;background:#0b0e12;color:#e8edf2;--panel:#121821;--card:#18212b;--line:#ffffff1b;--muted:#99a9b8;--blue:#8ab5d1;--gold:#b79b70;--danger:#e16e6e;--ok:#83c7a3}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:#0b0e12}button{font:inherit;color:inherit;border:1px solid #ffffff23;background:#ffffff08;border-radius:7px;padding:8px 11px;cursor:pointer}button:hover{background:#ffffff16;border-color:#ffffff40}button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #a7d2ed;outline-offset:2px}button.active,.mode.active{background:#35536a;border-color:#80afd0;color:#fff}#app{height:100dvh;display:grid;grid-template-rows:58px minmax(0,1fr);position:relative}header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;padding:7px 18px;background:#0e131a;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);z-index:4}.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;min-width:215px}.brand img{width:108px;height:48px;object-fit:contain}.brand span{font-size:12px;color:#b6c3ce;white-space:nowrap}.title{font-size:16px;font-weight:680;letter-spacing:.4px;white-space:nowrap}.top-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-left:auto}.top-actions button{font-size:12px}main{position:relative;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}#viewport{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden}canvas#scene{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;outline:none;touch-action:none}.viewbar{position:absolute;left:14px;top:14px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;max-width:min(72vw,720px);padding:7px;background:#0c1118c9;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}.viewbar button{font-size:12px;padding:7px 10px}.modebar{position:absolute;left:14px;top:76px;display:flex;gap:6px;padding:7px;background:#0c1118c9;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}.modebar button{font-size:12px}.help{position:absolute;left:16px;bottom:17px;background:#0c1118d9;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 11px;color:#c7d0d8;font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;max-width:370px}.status{position:absolute;right:14px;bottom:15px;background:#0c1118d9;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 10px;color:#becbd4;font-size:11px}.panel{position:absolute;z-index:3;right:12px;top:12px;bottom:12px;width:min(365px,calc(100vw - 24px));background:#111720ee;border:1px solid #ffffff24;border-radius:12px;backdrop-filter:blur(16px);box-shadow:0 18px 48px #0008;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform .22s}.panel.collapsed{transform:translateX(calc(100% + 20px))}.panel-head{padding:14px 15px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.panel-title-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}.panel-head h1{font-size:16px;margin:0}.panel-head p{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;margin:5px 0 0}.tabs{display:flex;gap:5px;padding:10px 12px 0}.tabs button{font-size:12px;flex:1}.content{padding:10px 13px 20px;overflow:auto;scrollbar-color:#546475 #121821;line-height:1.55}.section{background:#ffffff06;border:1px solid #ffffff12;border-radius:9px;padding:11px;margin-bottom:9px}.section h2{font-size:13px;margin:0 0 8px;color:#dce6ec}.section p{margin:5px 0;color:#c1cbd3;font-size:12px}.small{font-size:11px!important;color:#98a8b6!important}.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px}.metric{background:#ffffff07;border-radius:7px;padding:7px}.metric b{display:block;font-size:13px}.metric span{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}.toggle-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:12px;margin:7px 0;color:#d4dde4}.toggle-row input{accent-color:#72a9cc}.speaker-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:13px 1fr auto;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:11px;padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff0a}.swatch{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:3px}.tag{font-size:10px;color:#aebdca}.legend{position:absolute;right:14px;top:14px;z-index:2;background:#0b1118d9;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;min-width:160px;font-size:11px}.legend[hidden]{display:none}.legend-row{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;margin:4px 0}.legend-dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%}.bottom-controls{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:13px;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;gap:6px;z-index:2}.bottom-controls button{font-size:11px;background:#0c1118d9}.badge{display:inline-block;font-size:10px;padding:2px 6px;border:1px solid #ffffff22;border-radius:10px;color:#b2c2ce;margin-left:4px}.alert{display:none;background:#421d22;border:1px solid #be5b66;color:#ffd8db;border-radius:8px;padding:9px;font-size:11px;margin:8px 0}.alert.show{display:block}.photo-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:5px}.photo-grid button{padding:3px;overflow:hidden}.photo-grid img{display:block;width:100%;height:54px;object-fit:contain;background:#080b0f}.photo-grid span{font-size:9px;display:block;color:#b9c6d0}.dialog{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:9;background:#000d;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px}.dialog.open{display:flex}.dialog-card{width:min(740px,96vw);max-height:92dvh;background:#151c25;border:1px solid #ffffff30;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.dialog-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 13px}.dialog-card img{min-height:180px;max-height:76dvh;width:100%;object-fit:contain;background:#080a0d}.dialog-nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:8px 12px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}.status-panel{font-size:10px;color:#99a8b5;margin:8px 0}.engineer{display:none}.engineer.on{display:block}#loading{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:6;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#0a0d11;color:#c5d1db;font-size:14px;transition:opacity .3s}#loading.done{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}#toast{position:absolute;z-index:8;top:16px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#1b2a34;border:1px solid #81b6d0;color:#edf8ff;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .2s}#toast.show{opacity:1}body.text-hidden .help,body.text-hidden .status,body.text-hidden .labels{display:none}body.maximized header{display:none}body.maximized #app{grid-template-rows:1fr}body.maximized .panel{top:10px;bottom:10px}.labels{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}.scene-label{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:#10171edb;color:#e8edf2;border:1px solid #ffffff33;border-radius:4px;padding:2px 5px;font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap}#map{width:100%;height:145px;border-radius:6px;background:#0c1117;border:1px solid #ffffff18}
@media(max-width:760px){#app{grid-template-rows:52px 1fr}.brand{min-width:0}.brand img{width:76px;height:40px}.brand span{display:none}.title{font-size:13px}.top-actions button{padding:7px;font-size:10px}.viewbar{max-width:calc(100vw - 24px);left:8px;top:8px;gap:4px;padding:5px}.viewbar button{font-size:10px;padding:6px 7px}.modebar{left:8px;top:66px;padding:5px}.modebar button{font-size:10px;padding:6px 8px}.panel{right:6px;top:auto;bottom:5px;width:calc(100vw - 12px);height:min(51dvh,430px);border-radius:12px}.panel.collapsed{transform:translateY(calc(100% + 15px))}.panel-head{padding:9px 12px}.panel-head h1{font-size:14px}.tabs{padding-top:6px}.content{padding:7px 10px}.help{bottom:8px;left:8px;max-width:60vw;font-size:10px}.status{right:8px;bottom:8px;font-size:9px}.legend{right:8px;top:112px;min-width:125px;font-size:10px;padding:6px}.bottom-controls{bottom:8px;right:8px;left:auto;transform:none;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end;width:160px}.bottom-controls button{font-size:9px;padding:6px}.scene-label{font-size:9px}.photo-grid img{height:43px}}

.scene-label.angle{background:#0b1118ef;border-color:#7da4bd;color:#dfeef7;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.scene-label.az{border-color:#6db5d2}.scene-label.el{border-color:#a68bd1}.scene-label.dim{border-color:#b79b70;color:#ead9bc}
body.lightbg{background:#f5f6f8}
body.lightbg .scene-label{background:#fffffff2;color:#25333d;border-color:#00000024}
body.lightbg #loading{background:#f2f4f7;color:#34424d}
body.lightbg .photo-grid img{background:#eef1f4}
.material-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:18px 1fr;gap:9px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff0c}
.material-chip{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid #ffffff25;margin-top:2px}
.material-card b{font-size:11.5px;color:#e6edf2}.material-card p{margin:2px 0!important;font-size:10.5px!important}
.material-note{font-size:10px;color:#8fa0ae;margin-top:8px}
body.mode-acoustic .material-card b{color:#e8f2ef}
.device-status{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px;margin-top:8px}
.device-status div{padding:8px;border:1px solid #ffffff12;border-radius:7px;background:#ffffff05}
.device-status b{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#e5edf4}.device-status span{font-size:9.5px;color:#91a1ae}
.finish-note{font-size:10px;color:#93a3af;margin-top:6px}
.finish-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px}
.finish-grid div{padding:8px;border:1px solid #ffffff12;border-radius:7px;background:#ffffff05}
.finish-grid b{font-size:11px;display:block;color:#e8edf2}.finish-grid span{font-size:9.5px;color:#91a2ae}
.info-dialog-card{width:min(760px,94vw);max-height:88dvh;background:#151c25;border:1px solid #ffffff30;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 24px 70px #000a}
.info-dialog-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:15px 16px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff18}
.info-dialog-head h2{font-size:17px;margin:0;color:#edf4f8}.info-dialog-head p{margin:4px 0 0;color:#91a4b2;font-size:11px}
.info-dialog-body{padding:14px 16px 18px;overflow:auto;line-height:1.6}
.info-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px;margin-bottom:12px}
.info-cell{background:#ffffff06;border:1px solid #ffffff12;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 10px}
.info-cell b{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#9eb1bf;margin-bottom:3px}.info-cell span{font-size:13px;color:#edf3f6}
.structure-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin:12px 0 7px;color:#dce8ee}
.structure-stack{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:4px;min-height:82px;margin:0 0 12px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:3px}
.structure-layer{min-width:105px;flex:1;border-radius:7px;padding:8px;border:1px solid #ffffff20;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;text-align:center;background:#ffffff08}
.structure-layer b{font-size:11px;color:#fff}.structure-layer span{font-size:9.5px;color:#d4dde4;margin-top:4px}
.structure-arrow{align-self:center;color:#91a5b3;font-size:18px;flex:0 0 auto}
.acoustic-copy{font-size:12px;color:#ccd6dd;background:#ffffff05;border:1px solid #ffffff10;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin:8px 0}
.product-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(210px,.9fr) 1.1fr;gap:14px;align-items:start}
.product-image-wrap{background:#eef1f3;border-radius:9px;min-height:230px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:10px;border:1px solid #ffffff20}
.product-image-wrap img{display:block;max-width:100%;max-height:340px;object-fit:contain}
.product-note{font-size:10px;color:#869aa9;margin-top:6px}
@media(max-width:680px){.info-grid,.product-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.product-image-wrap{min-height:180px}.structure-layer{min-width:92px}}

body.mode-acoustic .panel{border-color:#537b78}body.mode-engineer .panel{border-color:#566f87}
@media(max-width:760px){.bottom-controls{width:210px}.bottom-controls button{font-size:9px;padding:6px 7px}}

/* Portrait controls retain access while keeping the 3D canvas readable. */
@media(max-width:760px){
 header{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:6px;padding:4px 8px;height:52px}
 .brand{min-width:0}.brand img{width:60px;height:38px}.brand span{display:none}
 .title{font-size:11px;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.title .badge{display:none}
 .top-actions{margin-left:0;gap:4px}.top-actions button{white-space:nowrap;font-size:10px;padding:6px 7px}
 #textBtn,#maxBtn{display:none}
 .viewbar{left:8px;top:8px;max-width:calc(100vw - 16px)}
 .modebar{left:8px;top:90px}
 .bottom-controls{left:8px;right:8px;bottom:40px;width:auto;transform:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:4px}
 .bottom-controls button{font-size:9px;padding:5px 7px;white-space:nowrap}
 .help{left:8px;bottom:8px;max-width:calc(100vw - 16px);font-size:9px}.status{display:none}
 #toast{top:150px;max-width:calc(100vw - 20px);white-space:nowrap}
}

/* ===== Mobile UI V9 ===== */
@media (max-width:760px){
  html,body,#app{width:100%;height:100%;height:100dvh;overscroll-behavior:none}
  body{overflow:hidden;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
  #app{grid-template-rows:48px minmax(0,1fr)}

  header{
    height:48px;
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:46px minmax(0,1fr) auto;
    align-items:center;
    gap:6px;
    padding:4px max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) 4px max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-left));
    background:#0d131aeF;
    backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  }
  .brand{min-width:0;width:46px;overflow:hidden}
  .brand img{width:44px;height:34px;object-fit:contain}
  .brand span{display:none}
  .title{
    min-width:0;
    overflow:hidden;
    text-overflow:ellipsis;
    white-space:nowrap;
    font-size:12px;
    letter-spacing:0;
  }
  .top-actions{display:flex;gap:4px;margin:0}
  .top-actions button{
    min-height:36px;
    min-width:42px;
    padding:6px 8px;
    font-size:10px;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  #textBtn,#maxBtn{display:none}

  main,#viewport{min-width:0;min-height:0}
  canvas#scene{touch-action:none}

  /* 视角与模式改为单行横向滑动，避免小屏换行互相遮挡 */
  .viewbar,.modebar,.bottom-controls{
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
    scrollbar-width:none;
  }
  .viewbar::-webkit-scrollbar,.modebar::-webkit-scrollbar,.bottom-controls::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
  .viewbar{
    left:max(7px,env(safe-area-inset-left));
    right:max(7px,env(safe-area-inset-right));
    top:7px;
    width:auto;
    max-width:none;
    display:flex;
    flex-wrap:nowrap;
    overflow-x:auto;
    gap:5px;
    padding:5px;
    border-radius:9px;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .viewbar button{
    flex:0 0 auto;
    min-height:36px;
    padding:6px 10px;
    font-size:10px;
  }

  .modebar{
    left:max(7px,env(safe-area-inset-left));
    right:max(7px,env(safe-area-inset-right));
    top:54px;
    width:auto;
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
    gap:5px;
    padding:5px;
  }
  .modebar button{
    min-height:36px;
    padding:6px 4px;
    font-size:10px;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }

  /* 底部功能键同样横向滑动，不再堆叠占据大面积画面 */
  .bottom-controls{
    left:max(7px,env(safe-area-inset-left));
    right:max(7px,env(safe-area-inset-right));
    bottom:max(7px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    width:auto;
    transform:none;
    display:flex;
    flex-wrap:nowrap;
    justify-content:flex-start;
    overflow-x:auto;
    gap:5px;
    padding:5px;
    background:#0c1118c9;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:9px;
    backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  }
  .bottom-controls button{
    flex:0 0 auto;
    min-height:36px;
    padding:6px 10px;
    font-size:10px;
    white-space:nowrap;
    background:#ffffff08;
  }

  /* 手机上默认作为底部抽屉，避免侧栏永久遮住 3D */
  .panel{
    z-index:5;
    left:max(6px,env(safe-area-inset-left));
    right:max(6px,env(safe-area-inset-right));
    top:auto;
    bottom:max(6px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    width:auto;
    height:min(58dvh,520px);
    max-height:calc(100dvh - 110px);
    border-radius:14px 14px 10px 10px;
    box-shadow:0 -14px 42px #000a;
    transition:transform .24s ease;
  }
  .panel.collapsed{transform:translateY(calc(100% + 18px))}
  .panel-head{
    flex:0 0 auto;
    padding:9px 10px 7px;
    background:#111720fa;
    border-radius:14px 14px 0 0;
  }
  .panel-head::before{
    content:"";
    display:block;
    width:42px;
    height:4px;
    border-radius:999px;
    background:#ffffff35;
    margin:0 auto 7px;
  }
  .panel-head h1{font-size:13px}
  .panel-title-row>div{min-width:0}
  #closePanel{min-width:38px;min-height:34px;padding:4px 9px}
  .tabs{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
    gap:4px;
    padding:7px 0 0;
  }
  .tabs button{min-height:36px;padding:6px 3px;font-size:10px}
  .content{
    flex:1 1 auto;
    min-height:0;
    padding:8px 9px calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    overflow:auto;
    overscroll-behavior:contain;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
  }
  .section{padding:9px;margin-bottom:7px}
  .section h2{font-size:12px}
  .section p,.toggle-row{font-size:11px}
  .grid,.finish-grid,.device-status{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5px}
  .metric,.finish-grid div,.device-status div{padding:7px}
  .speaker-row{font-size:10px;grid-template-columns:11px minmax(0,1fr) auto}
  .photo-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .photo-grid img{height:48px}

  .help,.status{display:none}
  .legend{
    right:max(7px,env(safe-area-inset-right));
    top:100px;
    min-width:118px;
    max-height:38dvh;
    overflow:auto;
    font-size:9px;
    padding:6px 8px;
  }

  /* 场景文字缩小并防止撑出屏幕 */
  .scene-label{
    max-width:42vw;
    overflow:hidden;
    text-overflow:ellipsis;
    font-size:8.5px;
    padding:2px 4px;
  }

  /* 声学 / 工程产品弹窗改为手机全宽可滚动卡片 */
  .dialog{
    position:fixed;
    padding:max(6px,env(safe-area-inset-top)) max(6px,env(safe-area-inset-right))
            max(6px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) max(6px,env(safe-area-inset-left));
    align-items:flex-end;
  }
  .info-dialog-card,.dialog-card{
    width:100%;
    max-width:none;
    max-height:92dvh;
    border-radius:14px 14px 9px 9px;
  }
  .info-dialog-head,.dialog-head{
    position:sticky;
    top:0;
    z-index:2;
    padding:10px 11px;
    background:#151c25fa;
  }
  .info-dialog-head h2{font-size:14px}
  .info-dialog-head p{font-size:10px}
  .info-dialog-head button,.dialog-head button,.dialog-nav button{
    min-height:38px;
    min-width:44px;
  }
  .info-dialog-body{padding:10px 11px 16px}
  .info-grid,.product-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .info-cell{padding:8px}
  .info-cell span{font-size:11.5px}
  .product-image-wrap{min-height:150px;max-height:30dvh;padding:7px}
  .product-image-wrap img{max-height:27dvh}
  .structure-stack{min-height:70px}
  .structure-layer{min-width:96px;padding:7px}
  .dialog-card img{min-height:120px;max-height:64dvh}
  #toast{
    top:106px;
    max-width:calc(100vw - 18px);
    font-size:10px;
    white-space:normal;
    text-align:center;
  }

  /* 加载/错误页手机阅读优化 */
  #loading{padding:max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-top)) 12px max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
  #scene-error{max-height:86dvh;overflow:auto}
}

/* 小尺寸手机 */
@media (max-width:390px){
  header{grid-template-columns:40px minmax(0,1fr) auto}
  .brand{width:40px}.brand img{width:38px}
  .title{font-size:11px}
  .top-actions button{min-width:38px;padding:5px 6px;font-size:9px}
  .viewbar button,.bottom-controls button{padding-left:8px;padding-right:8px}
  .grid,.finish-grid,.device-status{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}

/* 手机横屏：侧栏改为右侧抽屉，保留较大的 3D 可视区域 */
@media (max-width:920px) and (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:520px){
  #app{grid-template-rows:42px minmax(0,1fr)}
  header{height:42px;grid-template-columns:40px minmax(0,1fr) auto;padding-top:2px;padding-bottom:2px}
  .brand{width:40px}.brand img{width:38px;height:30px}
  .viewbar{top:6px;right:46%}
  .modebar{top:48px;right:46%}
  .bottom-controls{right:46%;bottom:max(5px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
  .panel{
    left:auto;
    top:5px;
    right:max(5px,env(safe-area-inset-right));
    bottom:max(5px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    width:min(44vw,390px);
    height:auto;
    max-height:none;
    border-radius:12px;
  }
  .panel.collapsed{transform:translateX(calc(100% + 18px))}
  .panel-head::before{display:none}
  .help,.status{display:none}
  .legend{top:88px;right:calc(44vw + 12px)}
  .dialog{align-items:center;padding:5px}
  .info-dialog-card,.dialog-card{width:min(760px,96vw);max-height:94dvh;border-radius:12px}
  .product-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(180px,.85fr) 1.15fr}
  .info-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}

</style>
<style id="presentationStyles">
/* Additive experience shell. V10 styles remain unchanged for free 3D touring. */
[hidden]{display:none!important}
#experienceLanding{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:20;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:auto;padding:40px max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) 40px max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-left));background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 75% 5%,#263441 0,transparent 54%),linear-gradient(135deg,#141b24,#080c12 74%);color:#ecf0f3}
.landing-inner{width:min(940px,100%)}
.experience-logo{width:142px;height:66px;object-fit:contain;object-position:left center;filter:brightness(0) invert(1);opacity:.9}
#landingTitle{font-size:clamp(29px,4vw,58px);font-weight:650;letter-spacing:.02em;margin:48px 0 16px;line-height:1.2}
.landing-subtitle{font-size:clamp(16px,1.7vw,23px);color:#b2bdc8;margin:0 0 52px}
.entry-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:22px}
.entry-grid button{display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;gap:20px;padding:30px 28px;border-radius:12px;background:#ffffff05;border-color:#b7c2cf30;min-height:164px;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s}
.entry-grid button:hover{background:#ffffff0e;border-color:#b79b70}
.entry-grid strong{font-size:26px;font-weight:600;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;color:#e9e4db}
.entry-grid strong span{color:#b79b70;font-weight:400}
.entry-grid button>span{font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;color:#aebbc7}
#entryStatus{color:#7f93a5;font-size:12px;min-height:20px;margin:26px 0 0}
body.experience-landing #app{visibility:hidden}
body.experience-landing #loading{z-index:21;pointer-events:none;background:transparent;display:none}
body.experience-landing #loading:has(#scene-error){display:grid;background:#0a0d11dd}
body.experience-presentation #app{grid-template-rows:minmax(0,1fr)}
body.experience-presentation #app>header,body.experience-presentation .viewbar,body.experience-presentation .modebar,body.experience-presentation .bottom-controls,body.experience-presentation .panel,body.experience-presentation .help,body.experience-presentation .status,body.experience-presentation .legend,body.experience-presentation #labels{display:none!important}
body.experience-presentation #viewport{right:35%;top:90px;bottom:82px}
#presentationShell{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:5;pointer-events:none;color:#e8edf2}
#presentationShell button,#presentationCopy,#presentationDirectory{pointer-events:auto}
.presentation-top{position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto;min-height:82px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px 30px;background:#0d131bf5;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff16}
.presentation-top .experience-logo{height:56px;width:120px}
.presentation-top nav{display:flex;gap:9px}
#presentationShell button{min-height:44px;min-width:44px;font-size:14px}
#presentationCopy{position:absolute;right:0;top:82px;bottom:82px;width:35%;padding:38px 34px;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#141c27,#101720);border-left:1px solid #ffffff12;scrollbar-color:#536473 #101720}
#pageContent h1{font-size:clamp(25px,2.05vw,40px);line-height:1.32;margin:0 0 22px;font-weight:600;color:#f0ece6;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#pageContent .page-lead{font-size:clamp(15px,1.1vw,19px);line-height:1.8;color:#b9c7d2;margin:0 0 26px}
#pageContent p,#pageContent li{font-size:clamp(14px,.95vw,17px);line-height:1.8;color:#bdc8d1}
#pageContent ul,#pageContent ol{padding-left:22px;margin:24px 0}
#pageContent li{margin-bottom:15px;padding-left:4px}
#pageContent .copy-note{font-size:12px;color:#8ea2b3;line-height:1.65;border-top:1px solid #ffffff16;padding-top:14px}
.presentation-bottom{position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0;min-height:82px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:28px;padding:14px 20px calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));background:#0d131bf5;border-top:1px solid #ffffff16}
#presentationCounter{font-size:16px;color:#bdc4cb;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;min-width:82px;text-align:center}
#presentationShell button:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default}
#sequenceStatus{position:absolute;left:28px;bottom:110px;max-width:calc(65% - 56px);padding:12px 18px;border:1px solid #cbb27c66;border-radius:8px;background:#0d1724ef;color:#e3d3af;font-size:15px}
.presentation-metrics{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:18px;margin:26px 0}
.presentation-metrics div{flex:1 1 100px;border-top:2px solid #b79b70;padding-top:12px}
.presentation-metrics b{display:block;font-size:24px;color:#ede1cb;font-weight:500}
.presentation-metrics span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#8fa4b6;margin-top:5px}
.presentation-product{display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:160px;max-height:260px;background:#e9edef;border-radius:8px;padding:15px;margin:24px 0}
.presentation-product img{display:block;max-height:230px;max-width:100%;object-fit:contain}
#pageContent details{border-top:1px solid #ffffff20;margin-top:20px;padding-top:14px}
#pageContent summary{cursor:pointer;min-height:44px;color:#d7c198;font-size:14px}
#pageContent .info-cell span{font-size:12px}
.presentation-chain{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;margin:20px 0}
.presentation-chain>div{padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid #ffffff1b;border-left:3px solid #b79b70;background:#ffffff04}
.presentation-chain b{font-size:14px;color:#eee0c3}.presentation-chain small{display:block;color:#a4b7c4;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.65}
.presentation-chain>span{text-align:center;color:#8da3b6;padding:3px}
.presentation-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;table-layout:fixed}
.presentation-table th{text-align:left;color:#d3b987;font-weight:500;font-size:12px;padding:10px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff30}
.presentation-table td{vertical-align:top;padding:12px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff14;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:#becbd4}
.presentation-table th:first-child{width:19%}.presentation-table th:last-child{width:14%}
#presentationDirectory{position:absolute;top:82px;right:18px;bottom:88px;width:min(540px,calc(100% - 36px));padding:20px;background:#141c26f9;border:1px solid #ffffff30;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 24px 80px #000b;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain}
.directory-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:12px}.directory-head h2{font-size:20px;margin:0}
#directoryPages{display:grid;gap:5px}#directoryPages button{text-align:left;padding:10px 14px;display:flex;gap:16px;font-size:13px}#directoryPages span{color:#b79b70;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#tourHome{font-size:12px}
@media(max-width:760px){
 #experienceLanding{padding:26px 22px}.experience-logo{width:116px;height:54px}
 #landingTitle{margin-top:32px;font-size:31px;line-height:1.3}.landing-subtitle{font-size:17px;margin-bottom:34px}
 .entry-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}.entry-grid button{padding:22px;min-height:132px;gap:14px}.entry-grid strong{font-size:24px}.entry-grid button>span{font-size:13px}
 .presentation-top{min-height:64px;padding:5px max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) 5px max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-left));height:64px}.presentation-top .experience-logo{width:78px;height:45px}.presentation-top nav{gap:5px}
 #presentationShell button{font-size:12px;padding:8px}
 body.experience-presentation #viewport{top:64px;left:0;right:0;bottom:auto;height:calc((100% - 138px)*.57)}
 #presentationCopy{top:calc(64px + (100% - 138px)*.57);bottom:74px;width:100%;padding:20px 21px;border-left:0;border-top:1px solid #ffffff22;border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;background:#141c27}
 #pageContent h1{font-size:24px;margin-bottom:12px}#pageContent .page-lead{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:16px}#pageContent p,#pageContent li{font-size:14px;line-height:1.75}#pageContent li{margin-bottom:10px}
 .presentation-bottom{min-height:74px;padding:10px 12px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));gap:22px}
 #sequenceStatus{left:12px;bottom:calc(74px + (100% - 138px)*.43 + 12px);max-width:calc(100% - 24px);font-size:12px;padding:9px 12px}
 #presentationDirectory{top:64px;bottom:80px;right:8px;width:calc(100% - 16px);padding:15px}
 .presentation-product{max-height:190px;min-height:120px}.presentation-product img{max-height:160px}
 body.experience-tour .top-actions button,body.experience-tour .viewbar button,body.experience-tour .modebar button,body.experience-tour .bottom-controls button,body.experience-tour .tabs button{min-height:44px;min-width:44px}
 body.experience-tour #app{grid-template-rows:56px minmax(0,1fr)}body.experience-tour #app>header{height:56px;grid-template-columns:40px minmax(0,1fr) auto}
 body.experience-tour .modebar{top:62px}body.experience-tour .legend{top:122px}body.experience-tour #closePanel,body.experience-tour .info-dialog-head button,body.experience-tour .dialog-head button,body.experience-tour .dialog-nav button{min-height:44px;min-width:44px}
}
@media(max-width:920px) and (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:520px){
 #experienceLanding{padding:20px 34px}.landing-inner{max-width:760px}.landing-inner>.experience-logo{height:38px;width:94px}#landingTitle{margin:10px 0;font-size:27px}.landing-subtitle{margin-bottom:20px;font-size:15px}.entry-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:15px}.entry-grid button{min-height:110px;padding:18px;gap:10px}.entry-grid strong{font-size:21px}#entryStatus{margin-top:14px}
 .presentation-top{height:58px;min-height:58px;padding:4px 16px}.presentation-top .experience-logo{width:94px;height:44px}
 body.experience-presentation #viewport{top:58px;bottom:66px;height:auto;right:38%;left:0}
 #presentationCopy{top:58px;bottom:66px;right:0;width:38%;padding:18px;border-left:1px solid #ffffff16;border-top:0;border-radius:0}
 #pageContent h1{font-size:22px}#pageContent .page-lead,#pageContent p,#pageContent li{font-size:13px}

<style id="homeBrandStyles">

.entry-grid{gap:24px}
.entry-grid button{position:relative;min-height:196px;border-radius:12px;padding:25px 28px;gap:16px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#ffffff06,#ffffff02);border-color:#ffffff20}

  <div class="landing-inner">
